_comment: Sheldon policy manifest. Strategy decisions live here. George enforces the matching execution rails from execution_limits.json.

scoring._comment: source: 'missy' consumes Missy's default pool score; 'local' re-runs Sheldon's own pool scoring (kept for backtesting). contract_version: 1 consumes Missy pool_features v1 when a record carries pool_features_version>=1 (behind the pool_gate/pool_ranker flags); 0 keeps the legacy score gate for every record. gate: 'safety' means the v1 open gate reads safety.eligible/range_ready, never score. position_source: 'missy' scores positions from Missy's versioned position_features vector (policy stays Sheldon's); 'local' re-derives inputs from the raw position record. min_open_score is legacy only: it is the v0 fallback and is never used for v1 records once the flags are on. Raised 70->90, version 1->2 (owner default 2026-10-10, calibration item): 90 is ~p84 of the observed Missy score distribution (last 8 scans; open rate 91%->48% of eligible; local scorer equivalent ~16%).

pool_gate._comment: Missy pool_features v1 open gate. enabled=false keeps today's score gate for every record (Phase A). enabled=true gates v1 records on safety.eligible + data_quality.range_ready only; v0 records still use scoring.min_open_score and the legacy TVL/volume backstop. require_range_ready mirrors Missy's 'can this pool take a range at all?'. v0_fallback is documentation/audit only ('legacy').

pool_ranker._comment: Expected net fee yield ranker for v1 records. enabled=false keeps build_strategies sorted by score (Phase A). enabled=true ranks survivors by net_daily_pct = realized_fee_apr/365*expected_in_range_frac - conc*vol^2/variance_divisor - round_trip_slippage/hold_days, ties broken deterministically by pool_address. il_estimate_pct is a guard (max_il_pct), never a subtractive term. unknown_rank controls records with null expected_in_range inputs: 'last' ranks them after every measured pool, 'skip' drops them. enforce_min_net is off by default (rank all survivors; let MAX_POSITION_OPEN_PER_CYCLE cut).

pool_eligibility._comment_deprecated: Missy now owns min_pool_liquidity_usd, min_24h_volume_usd, min_fee_tvl_ratio, max_volatility_pct, max_turnover_ratio. Sheldon keeps bin_step_rule, min_open_score, windows, sizing, add/remove policy.

bin_step_rule._comment: Owner ruling 2026-10-19: any Meteora bin_step >= 4 allowed; 401+ is protocol-invalid (>400). Reject 1,2,3 and fail closed on missing/0/malformed.

close_emission._comment: 2026-10-16 duplicate-close ghost guards. Automated close emission is deferred (review item) when: the position scan is older than max_scan_age_seconds, the pool has a close-settlement event newer than the position scan (the scan cannot prove the position still exists), or a close for the same position_id is already in flight. Never blocks George-side or owner closes; claims unaffected.

readiness._comment: Phase 1 (2026-10-09): structured pre-open readiness. All checks mandatory in one cycle; a stale or missing scan blocks an open (fail closed).

sol._comment: Phase 1 (2026-10-09): real rent/fee/reserve model. reserve_lamports 20M -> 60M (owner default 2026-10-10, bug #5): must cover George's worst-case open SOL overhead (meteora 60M, calibrated from the 2026-10-10 live-fire opens) so a dust sweep never starves the next open.
sol._swappable_comment: Owner ruling 2026-10-25: idle SOL above reserve_lamports is deployable capital (it is the pipeline's X-side asset; plan_funding converts it when an open needs the stable side).

rotation._comment: Phase 2 (2026-10-09): rotation open requires close + position + wallet + token + SOL confirmation. Declared here; enforcement lands in Phase 2.
rotation._dry_run_chain_truth_comment: Owner-approved 2026-10-19. dry_run only: resolve a close that was emitted but never executed when the position account is provably absent at confirmed AND finalized while its pool account still resolves. Live modes ignore this flag entirely - the journal ladder is the sole authority there.

recenter_policy._comment: Phase: active-bin drift recenter (2026-10-23). An in-range position fires a recenter (close + reopen in the same pool, new range centered on the active bin) when drift >= max(min_drift_bins, drift_frac_of_half_width * half_width), the position is older than min_hold_hours (falls back to the top-level min_hold_hours), the pool cooldown has elapsed, the recent active-bin trend matches the drift direction, the per-pool daily cap allows it, and value + composition are known (fail closed on unknown data). Cooldowns/daily counters record only when a signal is actually written. OOR positions stay owned by the close rail.

range._comment: Volatility-adaptive range width (strategy/range). width_factor: cover +/- volatility*width_factor per side. min_half_width: absolute floor in bins (Meteora) / raw 1bp ticks (Orca, Raydium). min_half_fraction: floor as a price fraction per side (0.01 = +/-1%) so the floor means the same price width on every DEX/tick-spacing; added 2026-10-14 after the Czfq3xZZ SOL-USDC incident where the tick-count floor let a ts=4 Whirlpool open at +/-0.1% and hit its edge in 45 minutes.

strategy_config._comment: Phase 2 strategy selection (2026-10-23, v1 ranker 2026-10-29). Regime-based selector chooses Spot/Curve/BidAsk per signal. min_tvl_usd: pools below this TVL only get Spot. trend_threshold: abs active-bin drift (bins) counting as trending. vol_threshold_pct: volatility percentile above which Curve/BidAsk are favoured. high_net_daily_pct: v1 ranker input above which Curve/BidAsk unlock (net fee yield %/day). high_score_threshold: legacy v0 score threshold (kept for the contract_version:0 branch). curve_half_width_bins: half-width for Curve ranges. bidask_gap_bins: gap between bid_range.upper and ask_range.lower. bidask_half_width_bins: half-width for each BidAsk side.
